title: AI Engineer
reason: Stack +26; Title fit +12; Exp fit +10; US +10
description_preview:
OneMagnify is an AI native, platform-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets.
Our AI team is seeking a client-facing Technical AI Engineer who is passionate about building strong client partnerships and delivering exceptional outcomes. This role is ideal for a highly organized professional who thrives in collaborative environments and is motivated by outstanding client delivery.
The AI Engineer will support the development and deployment of AI initiatives while ensuring high-quality execution, timely delivery, and a consistently high level of service for our clients.
About You:
A skilled multi-tasker who can prioritize and consistently balance multiple tasks with a highly developed sense of accountability and effortless ability to make significant contributions to initiatives
A go-getter with unrivaled proactivity paired with a positive, can-do attitude who thrives in a fast-paced environment
A natural-born communicator, connecting the dots when others cannot and simplifying sophisticated issues
A genuine people-person who lives for building relationships and excels in collaboration mode
An experienced consultant with extraordinary communication, interpersonal, organizational, and project/time management skills
What you’ll do:
As a technical developer our AI team, work with strategic clients to help them utilize their data to take action
Stay up-to-date on the latest AI tools and features
Provide Technical solutioning for our generative AI projects
Participate in code reviews and solutioning sessions with our data scientists, ai engineers, software engineers, and other technical resources
Lead cross-functional projects and enable collaboration across artificial intelligence and OneMagnify
What you’ll need:
Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university. Master's degree preferred.
Experience with Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Large Language Models
Object-oriented programming experience
Working knowledge of DataBricks
2+ years in a technical role with experience leading projects. 2+ years if educational level is masters.
Solid understanding of data analytics and business intelligence tools such as Python, R, SQL, Domo, Tableau, and PowerBI
Expert presentation skills
Experience in integrated marketing, digital agency, marketing services, or consulting environments preferred.
Benefits
We believe great work happens when people have the support and flexibility they need to thrive. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan, paid holidays, and
Flexible Time Off (FTO)
so you can take time away to recharge when you need it. We also offer additional programs focused on wellness, financial security, and professional growth.
We are an equal opportunity employer
We believe that Innovative ideas and solutions start with unique perspectives. That’s why we’re committed to providing every employee a workplace that’s free of discrimination and intolerance. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively search for like-minded people to join our team.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform job functions, and to receive benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Automation Engineer
reason: Stack +39; Title fit +6; Poor fit -6; US +10
description_preview:
Full-time Description
Position Overview:
We are looking for a proactive and skilled Automation Engineer to spearhead the development and management of automation solutions within our organization. This role focuses on enhancing operational efficiency by automating routine tasks and data workflows, particularly in Excel spreadsheets, survey systems, and other operational tools. The ideal candidate will be adept at creating robust, scalable automated processes that streamline operations and improve accuracy.
Key Responsibilities
Automated Systems Development:
Design and deploy automation solutions to streamline operations, focusing on Excel spreadsheet management, survey response handling, and other administrative tasks.
Design, build, and manage automated workflows using Power Automate/Azure to enhance business processes.
Troubleshoot and optimize existing workflows for efficiency and scalability.
Programming & System Integration: Develop scripts and applications to integrate disparate systems and ensure seamless data flow across platforms.
Operational Collaboration: Work with various departments such as IT, operations, and administration to identify bottlenecks and deploy automation strategies to enhance productivity.
System Troubleshooting: Proactively identify, debug, and resolve issues in automated processes, ensuring operational continuity and system reliability.
Process Optimization: Continuously monitor automated systems, analyze performance, and implement improvements to boost efficiency and reduce operational costs.
Documentation & Training: Generate comprehensive documentation on automated systems and provide training to end-users to ensure effective implementation and utilization.
Innovation and Research: Keep abreast of the latest automation technologies and methodologies, recommending upgrades and innovations that keep the organization at the forefront of operational excellence.
Microsoft 365 Integration
Leverage Microsoft 365 tools (SharePoint, Teams, PowerApps, OneDrive, etc.) to develop integrated solutions.
Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for utilizing Microsoft 365 capabilities.
Requirements
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or related technical field or equivalent verifiable work history.
Proven experience in designing and implementing automation solutions, with a focus on operational applications.
Experience in programming with Python, Java, or similar languages and familiarity with database management is a plus.
Solid understanding of integration patterns and platforms that enhance data interoperability.
Strong analytical skills for effective problem-solving and system optimization.
Excellent communication abilities and experience working collaboratively across diverse teams.
Experience and proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Excel, SQL and MySQL databases, and automation platforms is an advantage.
Preferred Skills
Experience with advanced data manipulation and analysis techniques in Excel.
Knowledge of AI and machine learning techniques applied to automation.
Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement practices to enhance process efficiency.

title: Entry-Level Technical Solutions Engineer
reason: Stack +12; Title fit +6; Entry +15; US +10; H1B +8
description_preview:
Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.
Problem-solving with a purpose.
As a Technical Solutions Engineer at Epic, you’ll work on software that impacts 305 million patients around the world. Alongside customer counterparts, you’ll tackle mission-critical and complex problems – we’re
way
beyond “turn it off and on again” issues. You’ll need to diagnose the problem, identify a solution, and manage the implementation of the solution, sometimes across multiple physical locations and stakeholders. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/Jobs/Technical-Solutions-Engineer.
Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planet.
The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.
Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.
Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).
More than just important work
.
Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.
We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.
Bachelor's degree or greater
A history of academic excellence or professional success
Willingness to travel occasionally to customer locations
Eligible to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship
Relocation to the Madison, WI area (reimbursed)
COVID-19 vaccination

At PwC, our people in data and analytics engineering focus on leveraging advanced technologies and techniques to design and develop robust data solutions for clients. Those in data science and machine learning engineering at PwC will focus on leveraging advanced analytics and machine learning techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision making. Focused on relationships, you are building meaningful client connections, and learning how to manage and inspire others. As part of the People Tech & AI team you will develop, test, and validate Generative AI agents and data pipelines, promoting reliability, scalability, and alignment with PwC standards. This position provides an exciting opportunity to enhance your skills in automated testing and governance controls while contributing to innovative AI-driven solutions.

Apply automated testing and governance controls effectively
Analyze complex issues and provide actionable insights
Mentor and guide junior associates in their tasks
Uphold rigorous standards of quality and technical excellence

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Processing/Analytics/Science
At least 2 years of experience in data engineering, AI/ML engineering, or quality engineering
In lieu of a Bachelor's Degree, demonstrating, in addition to the minimum years of experience required for the role, three years of specialized training and/or progressively responsible work experience in technology for each missing year of college
What Sets You Apart
Demonstrating three years of specialized training in technology preferred
Experience with test automation and CI/CD pipelines
Familiarity with LLMs and prompt engineering concepts
Understanding enterprise data patterns and quality frameworks
Building and maintaining automated test suites for AI agents
Validating integrations with Power Automate platform
Executing LLM evaluation frameworks using defined metrics
Working with data scientists and ML engineers
Upholding professional standards and documentation expectations

Equity Only

Job Description
You will build the foundational infrastructure and interfaces for Rebase, an AI Operating System designed for complex enterprise environments. Working across the full TypeScript stack, you'll develop autonomous agents that operate within legacy systems while ensuring data remains secure and traceable. This is a high-impact, founding-level role focused on solving hard engineering challenges.
Location
USA or UK (Hybrid)
Why this role is remarkable
Work on a founding-level opportunity building "Private AI for Work," tackling the technical debt and legacy systems that modern AI tools usually cannot reach.
Join an ambitious team at the ground floor with significant ownership of the product roadmap and direct influence on company direction through heavy equity.
Build actual autonomous agent infrastructure that performs deep, traceable work in regulated environments, moving beyond simple AI wrappers to solve real-world enterprise problems.
What You Will Do
Develop and ship end-to-end features using TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL to support autonomous agent operations within customer infrastructure.
Architect and build secure APIs and interfaces that allow AI agents to interact with decades-old ERPs, homegrown databases, and regulated legacy systems.
Collaborate on AI infrastructure, implementing RAG pipelines and LLM integrations that prioritize fact-grounding and traceability for enterprise B2B customers.
The ideal candidate
Brings 3–5 years of experience shipping enterprise B2B products end-to-end, with a proven ability to manage complex UI, backend, and database architectures.
Possesses deep proficiency in the TypeScript ecosystem (React, Node.js) and PostgreSQL, ideally with experience in high-growth startups and Next.js or GraphQL.
Has hands-on experience building production-grade AI infrastructure, including autonomous agents or ML pipelines, rather than simple API wrappers.
Who are Jack & Jill?
Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

title: Software Engineer ($230k-$250k + Equity) at Valon Technologies, Inc.
reason: Blocked company: Jack & Jill
reject_reason: Blocked company: Jack & Jill
description_preview:
This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.
She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.
The next step is to speak to Jack.
Job Title
Software Engineer
Salary
$230k-$250k + Equity
Company Description
Valon Technologies, Inc. is a Series C fintech backed by a16z building an AI-native operating system for regulated finance. After proving their platform by managing $110B+ in loans with 60%+ margins, they are now deploying their unified mortgage servicing software to major enterprises across the industry.
Job Description
Join Valon Technologies, Inc. to build the foundational infrastructure for regulated finance. You will develop robust, scalable systems in Python and React that manage billions of dollars while navigating complex federal regulations. Working alongside a senior team from Stripe and Google, you’ll ship high-impact software that transforms archaic financial sectors into programmable, AI-ready operations.
Location
New York/San Francisco, USA or Remote
Why this role is remarkable
Work on a mission-critical "AI-native operating system" for the $11T mortgage industry, backed by top-tier investors like Andreessen Horowitz.
Join a high-density talent environment with engineers from Jane Street, Stripe, and Meta, offering unparalleled peer learning and technical autonomy.
Solve genuine complexity by building software that encodes rigid federal regulations into extensible codebases, rather than just building on legacy wrappers.
What You Will Do
Design and build robust, extensible infrastructure capable of handling $110B+ in loans and evolving state and agency compliance requirements.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product and Design to create seamless, data-rich experiences for enterprise clients and mortgage customers.
Scale backend services using Python, Docker, and Kubernetes on Google Cloud Platform to maintain 100% accuracy in high-stakes financial transactions.
The ideal candidate
Has 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building and scaling quality applications in complex, production-grade environments.
Demonstrates strong proficiency in Python or similar backend languages, with a track record of designing scalable distributed systems from scratch.
Possesses the communication skills and intellectual curiosity required to navigate the intersection of technical architecture and highly regulated financial industries.
Who are Jack & Jill?
Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
How does this work?
Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.
We never post fake jobs
This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.
